scope: Offline predeploy review. No live ancestry or PR execution is claimed. YES means enforced and verified with offline fixtures.
raceContract: Fresh backend revalidation; immutable full-tree and exact-byte proof; re-read default name/head and compare ancestry; final security-ref equality; then PR POST. No untrusted payload intervenes. GitHub does not offer an atomic lock across the final ref reads and PR creation; this is the same-execution freshness contract requested, not immunity to arbitrary later writers.
writeAmbiguity: Any failed write transport terminates. Never assume success or retry. A later external request can reuse content only after fresh authorization and exact remote proof.
metadataPolicy: Presentation only. Invalid, control-containing, non-allowlisted or oversized values use fixed fallbacks. Package display <=100, artifact <=72, versions <=32, advisory <=64; subject/title <=236. Full authoritative values remain untouched. 84 hostile field/value cases plus maximum-length test, and graph-level metadata forwarding tests.
regressionIsolation: 67 backend and 23 verifier spec files. Sources copied to /tmp; only hardcoded fixture repository paths relocated. Local Git URL rewrite and file-only transport, Maven -o with copied dependency cache. No assertion removed or stubbed. Expected fixture refs restored in the temporary clone. Sandbox EPERM failures rerun outside the sandbox with authorization. Root compose-config/isolation specs ran against original files read-only. Final metadata spec rerun after bounds change.
n8nAudit: Static source audit against files copied read-only from installed n8n 2.14.2. No import, activation, workflow execution or service mutation.
verificationCommands: node -r ts-node/register <each spec> (per-project cwd, isolated fixture configuration)
